SELECT 
    SUM(pl_sep.amount_cad) - aug_avg.avg_fx_rate * SUM(pl_sep.qty * pl_sep.unit_price_orig) AS fx_effect_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl_sep
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS avg_fx_rate
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
    WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period = '2026-08'
) aug_avg
WHERE pl_sep.currency = 'USD' AND pl_sep.period = '2026-09'
